g.text: The same bad file produced errors on the new proxy and
silent false positives on the old one
Unrelated to this incident, customer traffic was being migrated to a new proxy version, FL2.
Both versions were affected by the bad feature file, but the impact each one produced differed.
FL2 · THE NEW PROXY ENGINE
HTTP 5xx errors
Customers deployed on the new FL2 proxy
engine observed HTTP 5xx errors for any
traffic that depended on the bots module.
This also affected Workers KV and Access,
which rely on the core proxy.
FL · THE PREVIOUS PROXY ENGINE
Silent bot-score failure
Customers on the old FL engine did not see
errors, but bot scores were not generated
correctly and all traffic received a bot
score of zero.
Customers with rules that block bots would
have seen large numbers of false positives.
Customers who were not using the bot score in their rules did not see any impact.
Observed fact: both proxy behaviours are stated in the published account; neither is inferred here.
Cloudflare, “Cloudflare outage on November 18, 2025”, request-path section. All times UTC.
